strings.name: Yvonne Farrell
strings.summary: Farrell and Shelley McNamara developed Grafton Architects around educational buildings as public spaces of exchange, light and urban life. Their practice grew from Ireland to Milan, Lima and London, emphasizing materials, terrain and human scale. Teaching runs alongside design. They shared the 2020 Pritzker Prize, while the team's Town House later won British and European architecture awards.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated in architecture from University College Dublin, followed by a long teaching career.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Campus meets city
strings.highlights.h1.text: Bocconi, UTEC and Town House incorporate learning spaces and public activity within their architectural structures.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Collaboration and teaching
strings.highlights.h2.text: Works with McNamara and colleagues across design, curation and teaching, bringing architectural experience into public debate.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Shared the Tau Sigma Delta Gold Medal
strings.timeline.t1.text: She and McNamara received the 2026 honor for contributions to architecture and education.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Town House won the European award
strings.timeline.t2.text: Grafton's Kingston University building received the EU Prize for Contemporary Architecture—Mies van der Rohe Award.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Town House won the Stirling Prize
strings.timeline.t3.text: The building for learning, performance and public activity received RIBA's annual British architecture prize.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Shared the Pritzker Prize
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won with McNamara; Grafton's practice also received the RIBA Royal Gold Medal.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Curated the Venice Architecture Biennale
strings.timeline.t5.text: With McNamara, used Freespace to explore generosity and shared space in architecture.
strings.timeline.t6.title: UTEC won the RIBA International Prize
strings.timeline.t6.text: The Lima campus, completed in 2015, received the inaugural international prize.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Bocconi gained international attention
strings.timeline.t7.text: The completed Milan university building won World Building of the Year at the World Architecture Festival.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founded Grafton Architects
strings.timeline.t8.text: Established the Dublin office with McNamara and other partners, beginning a long collaboration.
